alternative: The brief's additive formula a*rel + b*compat
decision: Multiplicative utility rel^a * compat^b with a hard gate
experiment: Same holdout candidates/relevance/compatibility; rank by each combination rule; count hard-constraint violations (hard_gate == 0) among the top-10 of every holdout trip.
metric: hard-constraint violations in top-10; mean compat@10; NDCG@10
